text.description_html:
Acorn AH8BQ, 7" Smooth Iron H-L Hinge

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths. The 7 Inch Smooth Iron H-L Hinge can be used on either interior or exterior doors. The Smooth Iron H-L Hinge smooth iron finish is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it was originally forged. It has a lifetime no rust warranty.

Specifications of the 7 Inch Smooth Black Iron Hinge:

  • Height: 7"
  • Overall Width: 6-3/4"
  • Thickness: 7/64" (.110)

Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Priced and sold as a pair. (2-hinges).
